headline: EPPO Charges Spanish National in €213.7 Million Bulgarian Railway Funding Fraud
summary: The European Public Prosecutor's Office filed an indictment against a Spanish national over alleged fraud involving more than €213.7 million in EU funds for modernizing the Sofia–Plovdiv railway.
why: The European Public Prosecutor's Office investigates fraud against EU budgets, and misuse of infrastructure funding affects the cost and delivery of public projects.
